name: skribbl-clone-workspace
description: Full-stack skribbl.io clone with real-time WebSockets, canvas drawing, and scoring

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
